blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Angelica Lopez, the Philippine contestant in the Miss Grand International beauty competition 2026 has earned a place among its last 25 contenders. She also received the award for Best in National Costume, having showcased Philippine folklore by wearing an attire inspired by the Mangkukulam. The attire is prescient of the coming Halloween, as the Mangkukulam is akin to the Western sorceress and appears in Philippine traditions as a practitioner of dark magic.
